Runway pricing

Short answer: Runway has a free plan, and paid plans start at $12 a month (billed annually). Free tier: 125 one-time credits. We checked every plan below on the official pricing page on Oct 18, 2026.

Every plan

PlanBilled annuallyBilled monthlyWhat you get
Free$0/mo$0/mo125 one-time credits
Standard$12/mo$15/mo625 credits/mo (about 52s of Gen-4.5)
Pro$28/mo$35/mo2,250 credits/mo
Max$76/mo$95/mo9,500 credits/mo; up to one month of unused credits rolls over

"n/a" means that billing option isn't listed. Prices exclude tax. Source: official pricing page.

  • Pro: $336 a year billed annually vs $420 paying monthly. Annual saves $84 (20%).
